rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because blast_radius >= 4 (production cluster workloads affected) and severity >= 4 (unversioned 'latest' image risks deploying untested code to production); Sub-classifier B fires on mutates_persistent_state (Helm release state and running workloads are permanently changed) and no_rollback_procedure (previous release values not snapshotted, making a clean helm rollback unreliable).
